title: Offers and the compiler follow the current run: the rejected run is withheld, the REVISION successor is compiled and offered, activity carries the approval verdict
description:
SPIDR child 2a of task-957bccf162b446f3a4db46b56e8e8f3a (grandparent task-6061e05cd17540a1bbe08b965da58b64). dependsOn child 1 task-3780109018bb49b2bf3a00b18952d7ff (REJECT commits: `currentPlanningRun(store, planningRunRef)` in apps/daemon/src/planning/current-planning-run.ts, the REVISION successor at version 1, successorRunId on the PlanningRunRejected event, `decisionReason` on the rejected run's approval.decide_intent decision) AND task-f6f33a3925bf4856b42cf84a37bb0f9e (the last row editing the shared ladder files affordance-planning-offers.ts / affordance-read.ts - serialised so no two rows edit them at once). Filed by architect-16a01670 2026-09-04, measured at main 9e9b7b04.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: daemon-only. (a) The offer ladder resolves the goal's CURRENT run; (b) the compile dispatcher compiles the successor; (c) the activity read carries the approval verdict. No mission text, no wrapper, no e2e, no UI (child 2b + child 3).

MEASURED (re-measure before planning):
- apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-planning-offers.ts (182 at plan time; 8145137c + f6f33a39 add `closeReadiness` / `landedCommit` facts to PlanningOfferInput :36-41): every read of the goal's run keys on the IMMUTABLE `goal.planningRunRef` - `planReviewable(ledger, goal.planningRunRef)` :115, the plan.propose target :129, the approval.decide / approval.decide_intent targets :137-138, `runCounts` + `refs[goal.planningRunRef]` :157-168 (planningGoalRefs binds run -> goal on the surface, affordance-contract.ts:66-73). The ladder has NO store: add a fact `currentRun: (planningRunRef: string) => string` to PlanningOfferInput, composed in affordance-read.ts (:264-269, 422+ lines pre-existing over cap) from child 1's `currentPlanningRun(config.store, ref)`; resolve it ONCE per goal and use it for planReviewable, the approval targets, versionOf and `refs` (so `planningGoalRefs[successorRunId] === goalId`); keep `runCounts` keyed on the immutable ref (uniqueness of the goal-run binding is unchanged). After a REJECT the rejected run is not PLAN_REVIEW, so decide_intent is withheld and the compiler ladder re-offers `planning.submit_decomposition` for the goal (:122-128) - assert both.
- apps/daemon/src/planning/compile-dispatcher.ts (341): `const runId = provenance.planningRunRef` :184 -> resolve through `currentPlanningRun(store, provenance.planningRunRef)`; ids :117-125 keyed on revision digest + runId (the successor gets its own stem); `runVersion = store.getAggregateVersion(runId)` :245; `runVersion === 0` creates INITIAL + ready + claim + propose (:258-296), `runVersion !== 1` refuses SUBMIT_DECOMPOSITION_ALREADY_FINALIZED (:297-300), then finalize at expectedVersion 4 (:303-310). MEASURE what a version-1 run means today (the fall-through goes straight to finalize at version 4 and cannot commit) - child 1 leaves the REVISION successor at version 1 (create_draft committed as a leg), so a `runVersion === 1` branch dispatches ready (v1) -> claim (v2) -> propose (v3, `proposalKind: \"REVISION\"` when the run state's runKind is REVISION; planning-command-contract.ts:197-200 admits INITIAL|REVISION) then finalize (v4). The one-node fence (:191-197) is untouched. compile-dispatcher.test.ts (292) pins the INITIAL chain - stays green unchanged.
- apps/daemon/src/http/activity-read.ts (200): `VERDICT_KINDS` :77 = escalation.decide + review.submit; `verdictOf` :80-92 reads `decision` / `routing.route`. Add `approval.decide_intent` and `approval.decide` reading the committed result's `decision` (child 1's REJECT result is {decision, decisionReason, findingsRef, runId, successorRunId}; measure the APPROVE result's field); activity-read.test.ts:113-119 has the arm pattern; apps/control-room/src/v2/ops/activity-words.ts:69 already renders both words (no UI change).

FEATURE: after child 1's REJECT, `/affordances/read` withholds `approval.decide_intent` for the rejected run and offers `planning.submit_decomposition` for the goal with `planningGoalRefs[successorRunId] === goalId`; `planning.submit_decomposition` compiles the successor (REVISION, version 1 -> PLAN_REVIEW) and the surface then offers `approval.decide_intent` targeting the SUCCESSOR; `/activity/read` rows for approval.decide_intent / approval.decide carry `verdict: "REJECT" | "APPROVE"`.
definitionOfDone: Over a REAL store (child 1's reject fixture): `/affordances/read` after the REJECT offers NO `approval.decide_intent` targeting the rejected run, offers `planning.submit_decomposition` for the goal, and `planningGoalRefs[successorRunId] === goalId`; after the successor compiles, `approval.decide_intent` targets the successor and the rejected run is never re-offered - set-equality on `commandKind@target`, written red first (affordance-read-planning.test.ts; every existing arm green unchanged).

Compile dispatcher: `planning.submit_decomposition` for a goal whose current run is the REVISION successor at version 1 runs ready -> claim -> propose (proposalKind REVISION, ids keyed on the successor runId) -> finalize and the successor reaches PLAN_REVIEW; the INITIAL chain arms in compile-dispatcher.test.ts stay green unchanged; a second submission on the same successor refuses SUBMIT_DECOMPOSITION_ALREADY_FINALIZED (exact code + layer); the one-node fence arm unchanged.

Activity read: rows for approval.decide_intent carry verdict REJECT / APPROVE read from the committed result (real decisions from child 1's fixture), approval.decide likewise; every other kind's verdict unchanged (existing arms green); a malformed result yields null, never a throw.

Gates quoted with count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`; every touched production file under 250 except the pre-existing over-cap affordance-read.ts (growth <= 6 lines, size recorded) and compile-dispatcher.ts (341 -> <= 380: extract the version-1 command list into a sibling module if it would pass 400); refusals assert code AND layer; every arm mutated red once (global rail 1).
taskRails: RESOLVE, NEVER REWRITE: `goal.planningRunRef` stays immutable; every consumer resolves the current run through child 1's `currentPlanningRun`, measured per FILE with `grep -n planningRunRef`.
ONE-NODE FENCE UNTOUCHED: the REVISION submission keeps SUBMIT_DECOMPOSITION_MULTI_NODE_INITIAL; growth belongs to task-4423d2a4.

DAEMON ONLY: no mission text, wrapper, e2e or UI (children 2b and 3); a surface or read SHAPE change names every exact-key decoder and digest mirror (global rail: grep the SHAPE) - adding `verdict` values to existing rows is not a shape change; <=250 lines per production source, hard stop 400.

OFFERS FOLLOW THE CURRENT RUN — DELIVERED AND GREEN. DoD 1's pre-compile half is satisfied over a REAL store; its post-compile clause depends on step 4, which is blocked (step 2's note).

TEST FIRST, RED PROVEN: the three new unit arms were run before the production edit -> `Tests  3 failed | 22 passed (25)`, failing exactly `targets the approval offers at the SUCCESSOR once it is reviewable`, `offers the compiler for the goal while the successor is created but not yet proposed`, `offers NOTHING when the current run is bound to a DIFFERENT goal`.

PRODUCTION (apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-planning-offers.ts, 213 -> 232):
- `PlanningOfferInput` gains `readonly currentRun: (planningRunRef: string) => string` beside `closeReadiness`/`landedCommit` — a FACT, not a store handle, so the ladder stays pure.
- `offersForGoal(input, goal, runId)` now takes the RESOLVED run and uses it at all three sites: `planReviewable(input.ledger, runId)`, the `plan.propose` target, and both approval targets. `offer()` reads `versionOf(ledger, target)` so the fence follows automatically.
- `resolvePlanningOffers` resolves `const current = input.currentRun(goal.planningRunRef)` ONCE per goal and uses it for the ladder AND the binding, so the run an offer targets and the run the authority map binds cannot disagree. `refs[current] = goal.goalId`. `runCounts` stays keyed on the IMMUTABLE ref (goal-run uniqueness is unchanged).
- SUBTLETY MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED — the binding check is SPLIT. The RUN side moves to `current` (`stateOf(ledger, current)?.state?.goalRef`), the GOAL side keeps the IMMUTABLE ref: `durableGoalMatches` (:74-84) asserts `goalRecord["planningRunRef"] === runId`, and the goal's own record never moves off its original ref, so passing `current` there would have made EVERY rejected goal fail its own binding and lose all offers. The plan's "run the binding check against stateOf(ledger, current)" is right for the run half only.

COMPOSITION (apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-read.ts, 462 -> 468, +6 = DoD 4's cap exactly; pre-existing over the 400 cap, unchanged by me): `currentRun: (planningRunRef) => currentPlanningRun(config.store, planningRunRef).runId` inside `readSurface()`, so the walk is per-poll and cannot go stale between polls. Child 1's resolver returns the FOLD OBJECT `{hops, rejected, runId, unreadable}`, so `.runId` is the mapping — recorded in step 1 because the plan left it open.

WHY THE UNRESOLVED CASE ALREADY WORKS: after a REJECT the successor has no ledger record at all (step 2's measurement), so `planReviewable(ledger, successor)` is false and the compiler ladder answers — the DoD's "offers planning.submit_decomposition for the goal" falls out of the resolution rather than needing a special case.
